articles.title: Defence, self-reliance, and budgetary priorities: Sectoral opportunities in a shifting strategic landscape
articles.summary: India's defence sector is undergoing a significant transformation amidst evolving global geopolitical landscapes. The nation is strongly committed to achieving self-reliance (Atmanirbharta) and modernising its capabilities to meet strategic imperatives. This push is crucial for strengthening India's security and strategic position in a dynamic world, emphasizing indigenous development and advanced technology adoption.
